[[File:ExplosiveKnife.png|thumb|right|200px|One of Riff Tamson's explosive knives]]
The '''explosive knife''' was a type of [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]]. It consisted of a small hilt containing a retractable blade and an explosive charge. Once stabbed into an enemy, the explosive could be activated remotely, killing the target. The explosion could also be activated if struck by [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire. The shape of the blade made it difficult to remove once implanted in the victim.<ref name="Prisoners">{{TCW|Prisoners}}</ref>

During a [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|second battle]] on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Riff Tamson/Legends|Riff Tamson]] used explosive knives against several [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]]. Mon Calamari Prince [[Lee-Char/Legends|Lee-Char]] stole one of these knives and stabbed Tamson with it, then shot it with a [[Spear blaster|Mon Calamari spear blaster]]. The resulting explosion [[Death/Legends|killed]] Tamson, effectively removing any [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] threat of the [[Dac/Legends|planet]].<ref name="Prisoners" />
